title: Playing a Tiefling: lineage, paint hooks, and brief patterns that work
excerpt: Forty tiefling commissions taught us where the line sits between infernal and costume. Horns, skin, eyes, tail, subtype — what to brief and what to leave open.
seo_title: Tiefling Character Art: Lineage & Brief Hooks That Work
seo_description: How to brief a tiefling commission so it reads infernal but still human. Horns, skin tones, subtype cues, and what to leave to your painter.
